title: Directors' resolution in writing
summary: The directors change the registered office, and authorise the lodgement with ACRA.

paragraphs: We, being all the directors of {{.Company.Name}}, pass the following resolutions in writing, as the company's constitution allows.

sections.heading: Resolved
items: That the registered office of the company be changed {{if .Company.Office}}from {{.Company.Office}} {{end}}to {{.F.address}} with effect from {{.F.from}}.
That any one director or the secretary be authorised to lodge the change with ACRA.
